zh.page_description: 安装、启用或卸载 NoneBot 平台适配器
zh.uninstall_button_title: 彻底删除（取消注册并删除依赖）
zh.disable_toggle_tooltip: 禁用后将取消注册（依赖不删除）
zh.install_success: {name} 已安装并注册，重启后生效
zh.restart_after_install_confirm: 适配器 {name} 已安装，需要重启机器人生效，是否立即重启？
zh.restart_after_toggle_confirm: 适配器 {name} 的启停需要重启机器人生效，是否立即重启？
zh.no_config_hint: 暂无 {name} 的专属配置项
zh.uninstall_success: {name} 及其依赖已彻底删除（重启后生效）
zh.restart_after_uninstall_confirm: 适配器 {name} 已删除，需要重启机器人生效，是否立即重启？
zh.uninstall_dialog_description: 确定彻底删除 {name} 吗？这将取消注册并删除依赖包，不可恢复。
zh.uninstall_warning: 此操作将同时从 pyproject.toml 中移除注册信息和依赖，如需再次使用需重新安装。

en.page_description: Install, enable, or uninstall NoneBot platform adapters
en.install_success: {name} installed and registered, takes effect after restart
en.restart_after_install_confirm: Adapter {name} has been installed and requires a restart to take effect. Restart now?
en.restart_after_toggle_confirm: Enabling or disabling adapter {name} requires a restart to take effect. Restart now?
en.uninstall_success: {name} and its dependencies were fully removed (takes effect after restart)
en.restart_after_uninstall_confirm: Adapter {name} has been removed and requires a restart to take effect. Restart now?
en.uninstall_dialog_description: Fully remove {name}? This will unregister it and delete its dependencies. This cannot be undone.
en.uninstall_warning: This also removes registration info and dependencies from pyproject.toml. Reinstall it if you need it again.
